maia: quick sync re: rollout metadata for version cohabitation. want a compact, predictable shape that client libs can act on without bespoke heuristics. thoughts?

jordan: +1. propose flat fields: soft_deprecate_ts, hard_deprecate_ts, drain_flag, and optional priority. keep it machine-friendly so SDKs can implement a single codepath.

lee: operational gotcha: client pin caches and local routing can ignore soft windows. recommend adding a 'client_hint_ttl' to indicate how long clients should honor local pins after soft_deprecate. default 24h.

maia: good call. also add a freeform 'note' and a short enum 'coexist_mode' {"graceful", "immediate"} so semantics are explicit.

olivia: telemetry request from SRE: include 'rollout_phase' string and encourage clients to emit 'fallback_attempts' and 'last_seen_version'. also servers should publish webhook events on phase transitions.

jordan: example payload for control plane (compact):
```json
{
  "model_version": "redwood-qa-3.4",
  "soft_deprecate_ts": 4200030000,
  "hard_deprecate_ts": 4200100000,
  "coexist_mode": "graceful",
  "drain_flag": false,
  "priority": 5,
  "client_hint_ttl": 86400,
  "note": "latency regression on long sequences",
  "tenant_exceptions": ["acct-9001"]
}
```

maia: two implementation notes: 1) docs should recommend ISO 8601 in examples, unix seconds accepted in API; 2) precedence rules: tenant_exceptions > explicit pin > rollout weight. SDK must expose those and unit-test them.

lee: backoff policy: when client sees soft_deprecate_ts passed but server still routes to old version, client should attempt one immediate fallback probe then exponential backoff starting at 1s, cap at 30s, to avoid stampedes. add server probe endpoint to validate live routing.

olivia: add an opt-in 'coexist_policy' key later for advanced strategies (percent traffic thresholds, perf-based routing). keep v1 minimal.

maia: I'll draft an RFC follow-up with fields, SDK guidance, and sample e2e tests. opening PR and will ping @jordan @lee @olivia for review.

deploy-bot: canary roll for redwood-qa-3.4 started in eu-west-1 :rocket:
